Mold Springs

These are square (rectangular cross-section) coil springs used in mold (press mold · injection mold) knockouts, ejectors, cams, and slides. Our proprietary wire-forming process results in less longitudinal deformation and surface damage, giving the springs strong resistance to fatigue and stress. Depending on load capacity and deflection rate (compressible range), they are divided into 13 series — SF·SSF·SL·SSL·SM·SH·SB·SG·SY·SSY·SU·SC·SR, and in the catalog each series is also distinguished by spring color.
